# Cohort Timeline

## Summary
The rail: week columns, release marks (hollow until released), live dots, due/quiz marks, today needle. Full, compact and fitted densities from one component and one data shape (`TimelineWeek[]`).

## Usage
`<CohortTimeline @weeks={{weeks}} @todayIndex={{i}} @compact={{true}} />` — weeks from `buildCohortWeeks(cohort)`.

## Non-goals
No drag-to-reschedule.
attributes.cardDescription: A cohort's weeks as a rail: release marks, live sessions, due dates and quizzes, with a today needle, at full, compact or fitted density.
